# Jubilees Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Circumcision Commanded; Covenant of Abraham; Ishmael Circumcised

---

**15:1** And in the fifth year of the fourth week of this jubilee, in the third month, in the middle of the month, Abram celebrated the feast of the first-fruits of the grain harvest.

**15:2** And he offered new offerings on the altar, the first-fruits to the LORD, an heifer and a goat and a sheep on the altar as a burnt offering to the LORD; their fruit offerings and their drink offerings he offered upon the altar with frankincense.

**15:3** And the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him: "I am God Almighty; walk before me, and be thou perfect."

**15:4** "And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and I will multiply thee exceedingly."

**15:5** And Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, saying:

**15:6** "Behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations."

**15:7** "Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee."

**15:8** "And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee."

**15:9** "And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee."

**15:10** "And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God."

**15:11** And the LORD said unto Abraham: "And thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations."

**15:12** "This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised."

**15:13** "And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you."

**15:14** "And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed."

**15:15** "He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant."

**15:16** "And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant."

**15:17** And God said to Abraham: "As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be."

**15:18** "And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her."

**15:19** Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, "Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? And shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?"

**15:20** And Abraham said unto God: "O that Ishmael might live before thee!"

**15:21** And God said: "Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him."

**15:22** "And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation."

**15:23** "But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year."

**15:24** And God said to Abraham: "But as for thee, thou shalt keep my covenant, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations."

**15:25** And on that day Abraham was circumcised, and all the men of his house, both born in the house, and those that were bought, were circumcised with him.

**15:26** And the LORD commended the angels of the presence and the angels of sanctification to circumcise all who kept the law with the angels; and these two great classes were already in that condition of being circumcised from the day of their creation; and the LORD was pleased with Israel that they should be like these two classes of angels.

**15:27** Circumcise, therefore, your sons in the eighth day, for the covenant has been established for a perpetual decree, and let it not be broken on the sabbath day and on a feast day.

**15:28** Every male who has not been circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day, he is not of the children of the covenant which the LORD made with Abraham, but is of the children of destruction; and there is therefore no sign on him that he belongs to the LORD, and he is to be destroyed and to be slain from the earth, and to be rooted out of the earth, for he hath broken the covenant of the LORD our God.

**15:29** For all the angels of the presence and all the angels of sanctification have been so created from the day of their creation, and before Israel God caused them to hallow and make holy the sabbath day.

**15:30** And he caused not any people or nations to keep sabbath on that day, or to be circumcised or to observe the festivals and months, except Israel alone; and he allowed them to eat and drink and to be satisfied.

**15:31** For there are many nations and many peoples, and they all belong to him, and over all of them he has placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from him.

**15:32** But over Israel he did not appoint any angel or spirit, for he alone is their ruler, and he will preserve them and require them at the hand of his angels and his spirits, and at the hand of all his powers in order that he may preserve them and bless them, and that they may be his and he may be theirs from henceforth forever.

---
*EMET notes: Circumcision of the angels (v.26) — a Jubilees-unique doctrine: the two highest angel classes were created already circumcised; Israel's circumcision aligns them with the angelic order. V.31-32 articulate the Jubilees theology of nations: other nations are governed by subordinate spirits, but Israel is directly under God. This is a key text for Jubilees' theology of Israel's unique status.*
